The credential behind it reads 4-year garden service, 127 supervised plantings, pruning exam, annual charter fees, and that is the point. One proof costs 98 POA; 429 proofs cost 42042 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. The anchor is the credential, the ember is the bond, and the meadow is the clock that watches both. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
